newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Calan may seek listing - NZ Herald.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Calan may seek listing - NZ Herald.

text.p: Healthcare property investor Calan Group plans to raise around NZ$50 million through a share market float later this year, the New Zealand Herald reported on Friday.
The bulk of the funds would be used for a NZ$41 million development at Auckland's Ellerslie racecourse of a hospital and clinic. The project is scheduled to be completed late next year.
Calan had been eyeing a float for some time but had been waiting for bank bill rates to fall below 8.0 percent.
The paper said the logic behind this was that such listed vehicles normally tracked at a premium to asset backing in a low interest rate environment.
